source.changes: Filtered to living snake species; reshaped to one record per species with synonyms, common names, distribution text and source link. Serpent's venom assessments are not part of this data.
knownLimitations: Distribution text in this release keeps only the first line of multi-line entries, so it can be incomplete. Serpent shows it but does not use it to down-weight identifications.
